# Cross-verify: use PyMuPDF directly to extract text and check page count/file size
cross_check_script = """
import pymupdf
import os

pdf_path = "/workspace/testbed/docs/handbook.pdf"
file_size = os.path.getsize(pdf_path)
print(f"File size: {file_size} bytes")

doc = pymupdf.open(pdf_path)
print(f"Number of pages: {len(doc)}")

full_text = []
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    full_text.append(f"=== Page {i+1} ===")
    full_text.append(text)
    print(f"Page {i+1}: {len(text)} chars")

combined = "\\n".join(full_text)
print(f"\\nTotal extracted text length: {len(combined)} chars")
print("\\n--- FULL EXTRACTED TEXT ---")
print(combined)
"""
await write_file("./cross_check_pdf.py", cross_check_script)
print("Script written")

cross_check_out = await run_command("python ./cross_check_pdf.py")
print(cross_check_out)

# Parse out just the extracted text portion from the cross_check output
# The full text starts after "--- FULL EXTRACTED TEXT ---"
marker = "--- FULL EXTRACTED TEXT ---\n"
idx = cross_check_out.find(marker)
if idx >= 0:
    extracted_portion = cross_check_out[idx + len(marker):]
    # Remove trailing shell prompt
    if "(.venv)" in extracted_portion:
        extracted_portion = extracted_portion[:extracted_portion.rfind("(.venv)")].rstrip()
    # Remove the "=== Page N ===" headers to get pure text
    import re
    lines = extracted_portion.split("\n")
    clean_lines = [l for l in lines if not re.match(r'^=== Page \d+ ===$', l)]
    final_text = "\n".join(clean_lines).strip()
else:
    final_text = clean_text  # fallback

print(f"Final text length: {len(final_text)} chars")
print(repr(final_text))

save_result = await write_file("./output/handbook_extracted.txt", final_text)
print(save_result)

final_verify = await read_file("./output/handbook_extracted.txt")
print(final_verify)
